## ITAM

### Storytelling in Economics

::: {.eyebrow}
Master in Applied Economics · Spring 2025
:::

How to turn an empirical result into something a non-economist can act on:
structuring an argument, choosing what to show, designing tables and figures that
carry the point, and writing for policy audiences. Materials are public.
